🔧 **CAD Modelling Competition – Using CATIA V5** 💻

The Department of Mechanical Engineering, **Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (SRIT), Anantapur**, successfully conducted a **CAD Modelling Competition using CATIA V5** at the CAD Laboratory.

The competition provided Mechanical Engineering students with an excellent platform to demonstrate their **technical knowledge, creativity, modelling skills, accuracy, and time management abilities** through an experiential-learning activity.

The event encouraged students to strengthen their practical design competencies while gaining hands-on exposure to an **industry-relevant CAD tool**.

The initiative was conducted with the support and collaboration of the **IEI Students Chapter, Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC), and Green Manufacturing & Energy Systems Club**, fostering innovation, technical excellence, and sustainable engineering practices.

📍 **Venue:** CAD Laboratory, Department of Mechanical Engineering, SRIT

🩸 **Blood Donation Camp at SRIT**

On the occasion of the **12th death anniversary of Late Sri Aluru Sunki Reddy**, the NSS Unit of **Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (SRIT)**, in association with the **Government General Hospital** and **Manavatha Voluntary Organization**, organized a Blood Donation Camp.

Students, faculty members and non-teaching staff enthusiastically participated in the camp and donated **151 units of blood**.

**Dr. G. Balakrishna, Principal**, highlighted the importance of blood donation and noted that many patients facing accidents and various health emergencies lose their lives due to the non-availability of blood at the right time. He expressed happiness that blood donation drives like these help in collecting blood and contribute to saving precious lives. He appreciated the NSS team for organizing the programme and thanked the staff of the Government General Hospital for their valuable support in making the camp a success.

**Dr. U. Srinivas, Vice Principal**, congratulated the students, faculty members and staff who donated blood and appreciated their spirit of service and social responsibility. He stated that the institution would continue to organize more such community-oriented programmes in the future.

The programme was attended by **Dr. M. Ranjith Reddy, Vice President**, Heads of various departments, **Sri Tarimela Amarnath Reddy, Convener, Manavatha Blood Bank**, NSS Programme Officers, faculty members and students.

Together, we continue to contribute towards saving lives and serving society. ❤️

From Ideas to Impact! | Innovation & Entrepreneurship Workshop

The Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC), in association with the Department of ECE, IETE and INSPIRE Club, organized a one-day workshop on “Sessions on Accelerators and Incubation Opportunities” for IV Year I Semester ECE students.

The session provided valuable insights into startup incubation, accelerators, innovation ecosystems, mentoring, funding opportunities, technology commercialization, and the journey from idea → prototype → incubation → acceleration → market → scale.

With 62 students actively participating, the workshop encouraged young innovators to transform their ideas into impactful solutions and explore entrepreneurship as a career pathway. 💡🌱

⚡ Powering the Future with Smart Technologies!

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), in association with The Institution of Engineers (India) (IEI), organized a guest lecture on “Next-Gen Power: Smart LV/MV Panel Architecture.”

Industry expert Mr. Raju Kancharla, Engineer-1, Digital Systems Technical Execution – Electrical, Schneider Electric Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru, shared valuable insights into smart LV/MV panel architectures, digitalization, intelligent protection, monitoring, automation, and modern power distribution systems.

The session helped students understand how smart technologies are transforming conventional electrical infrastructure while providing exposure to emerging industry trends and practical applications.

The programme was coordinated by Mr. T. Aravind Babu, Assistant Professor, Department of EEE.

🔹 Connecting classroom learning with industry expertise!

Raising Capital & Finance Management for Start-ups

The **Institution’s Innovation Council**, in association with the **Department of ECE, IE(I) and INSPIRE Club**, organized an insightful workshop on **“Raising Capital and Finance Management for Start-ups”** for I Year II Semester ECE students.

The session introduced students to startup funding, financial planning and resource management, with insights into **bootstrapping, angel investment and government funding schemes**. Students also explored budgeting, cash flow management and financial decision-making through interactive discussions and real-world examples.

With **55 students** actively participating, the workshop strengthened their awareness of entrepreneurship and financial strategies for building sustainable ventures. 🚀💡

SRIT Raises Awareness on Anti-Ragging and POCSO Act

The Women Empowerment Cell (WEC) of Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (SRIT) organized an Awareness Programme on Anti-Ragging and the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act.

Sri Raja Sekhar, Secretary and Civil Judge, Senior Division, District Legal Services Authority, Ananthapuramu, served as the resource person and sensitized students on the legal and social consequences of ragging, student safety, reporting mechanisms, and the key provisions of the POCSO Act.

Sri Srinivasulu, Senior Advocate; Sri E. Nallappa, Senior Advocate; Sri Govindarajulu, Senior Citizen Association Legal Advisor; and Sri Firoz Khan also attended the programme and shared their valuable insights.

Dr. G. Balakrishna, Principal; Dr. P. Vinatha, WEC Coordinator; faculty members and students participated in the programme.

The interactive session empowered students with awareness about their rights, responsibilities, safety, prevention, and legal protection, contributing towards a safe and supportive campus environment.

SRIT Hosts Swachhata Pakhwada Programme

Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat), Anantapur, under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India, in association with the JNTU NSS Cell, NSS Unit of Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (SRIT), and the Indian Red Cross Society, organized a **Swachhata Pakhwada Programme** at the SRIT Auditorium.

The programme featured quiz, painting, photography and slogan-writing competitions to create awareness among youth about cleanliness and hygiene. Students, NSS volunteers and youth enthusiastically participated.

NSS Coordinator Dr. G. Mamatha, SRIT Principal Dr. G. Balakrishna, Deputy Tahsildar S. Gopinath, MY Bharat Coordinator Bisathi Bharat, NSS Programme Officers T. Aravind and Dr. Lakshmi Narayana, and President’s Awardee K. Jayamaruthi graced the programme.

The dignitaries highlighted the importance of cleanliness in daily life and encouraged youth to become ambassadors of a clean and healthy society. A **Swachh Bharat Pledge** was administered, followed by prize distribution and certificates of appreciation.

SRIT Students Shine at NFLQ 2026 – Southern Regional Round, Bengaluru

Students of **Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (SRIT)**, D. Chand Naveed (II CSE) and K. Venkata Sheshu (II CAD), represented SRIT at the **South Regional Round of the NISM–SEBI National Financial Literacy Quiz (NFLQ) 2026**, held in Bengaluru on August 8, 2026.

The students successfully progressed up to the **Proctored Round**, gaining valuable exposure to financial literacy and the securities market at the regional level.

As part of the event, SEBI and NSE organised an interactive financial awareness stall featuring the Wheel of Financial Wisdom, online quizzes and investor-awareness activities. The students actively participated, interacted with representatives from SEBI and NSE, and enhanced their understanding of financial literacy, investment awareness and the securities market.

They also received **goodies and participatory e-certificates** for their enthusiastic participation. 🏆🎁📜

👏 Congratulations to our students for representing SRIT and making the most of this enriching experience!

🤖 **ADV-GLE IBM Bob Course Workshop | SRIT** 💻

Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (Autonomous), Anantapuramu, conducted a three-day **ADV-GLE IBM Bob Course Workshop** under the IBM SkillsBuild initiative, in collaboration with Edunet Foundation and the Andhra Pradesh programme.

The workshop featured hands-on sessions on IBM SkillsBuild profile development, Artificial Intelligence certification, and IBM Bob (BOB) for code debugging, error identification, and AI-assisted problem-solving. Students also worked on practical problem statements, enhancing their logical thinking, coding skills, and technical proficiency.

The sessions were mentored by **Mr. P. Ajay Reddy, Master Trainer, and Mr. Shaik Nazeer Ali, Master Expert, Edunet Foundation.**

The programme was attended by **Dr. P. Veera Prakash Reddy, Head of the Department, CSE; Mr. Srinivasulu, Vice Principal; Ms. Sunitha, In-charge HOD;** and faculty coordinators of SRIT.

The workshop provided students with valuable practical exposure to AI-powered coding tools and emerging software development practices.

The Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (Autonomous), Anantapuramu, organized an Institution of Engineers (India)-sponsored one-day workshop on **“ANSYS Software: Tools and Applications”** to enhance students’ technical knowledge and practical understanding of engineering simulation tools.

The programme was inaugurated by Chief Guest **Dr. M. L. S. Deva Kumar**, Chairman, IEI Andhra Pradesh State Centre, and Guest of Honour **Dr. M. Rama Krishna Reddy**, Chairman, IEI Anantapur Local Centre (ALC), along with Principal **Dr. G. Balakrishna** and EEE HoD **Dr. G. Meerimatha**, through the ceremonial lighting of the lamp.

Resource Person **Dr. G. Hemachandra**, Assistant Professor, M. S. Ramaiah Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, delivered expert sessions on ANSYS tools and their practical applications in engineering analysis, simulation, and design optimization.

The workshop provided valuable insights into simulation-based engineering design, bridging theoretical knowledge with practical applications and equipping students with industry-relevant technical skills.

💰 **From First Salary to Financial Freedom – Financial Literacy Session**

Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute of Technology (Autonomous), Anantapuramu, organized an insightful guest lecture on **“From First Salary to Financial Freedom”** for fourth-year students across various departments.

Dr. K. Rajendra Prasad, SEBI Securities Market Trainer and NISM Financial Education Empanelled Resource Person, enlightened students on budgeting, savings, active and passive income, diversified investments, emergency funds, retirement planning, and **FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early)**.

The session highlighted the importance of developing sound financial habits, making informed investment decisions, and building long-term financial security from the beginning of one’s career.

The programme was organized by the **Department of Humanities and Sciences**, in association with the **Institution’s Innovation Council (IIC), BCDE, and NDLI Club**, to promote financial literacy and empower students to manage their finances responsibly.
